gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-nobile: Nasalization floats its letters well apart, with a big lowercase and short ascenders that feel friendly right away. Nobile follows in a plain sans, its caps sitting barely above the lowercase, so the two blend into one easygoing page.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-nokora: Nasalization draws everything with a marker-like, steady line.  Nokora's wide s and dark lowercase stripe give the lines below some weight, so a heading a size or two bigger would sit nicely above it.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-kufi-ara: Noto Kufi Arabic reads modern and open, with a welcoming gap in its c and capitals barely above the lowercase. And Nasalization, with no stroke modulation at all and short ascenders, feels like a friendly cousin standing right beside it.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans: Nasalization looks cut out with a fixed-width router bit, its big lowercase and calipers-style c spaced generously apart. Then Noto Sans takes over in sans-serif form, its lowercase filling most of the letter height and keeping the text plain and contemporary.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-adl: Friendly is the first impression from Nasalization, whose horizontals match its verticals in thickness and whose letters float apart. Noto Sans Adlam follows in clean sans, curve endings held apart, and a heading one step larger would sit comfortably above it.

Nasalization has a pipe-like body to every stroke, with short ascenders and a big lowercase that feels approachable. And Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined brings generous space between curve ends and stems, so the sans text stays modern and uncluttered beneath it.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-ana: Nasalization keeps its stems and arcs in lockstep, friendly and spaced out. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs adds outward-pointing terminal tips and an x-height rising near cap height, giving the sans-serif text a modern, grounded feel under the heading.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-ara: Friendly letters in Nasalization hold vertical and horizontal strokes at identical weight, floating apart above Noto Sans Arabic, a modern sans with a pronounced x-height. Its wide openings keep the text easy going.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-arm: Blueprint-lettering with a constant line, Nasalization spaces its big lowercase out like a drafting sheet beside a softer sans below. Strongest is the contrast between its fixed lines and Noto Sans Armenian's tall, full round letters.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-ave: Pen-drawn but precise, Nasalization strokes look made with a fixed nib, and its calipers-like c opens friendly and wide. Noto Sans Avestan answers with clean sans-serif lettershapes whose curve tips never touch, and that tall x-height is the quality that stands out most.
